projects.title: Villa Aurès — Contemporary Residence
projects.scope: Complete Architectural Renovation, Bespoke Joinery & Interior Styling
projects.description: A total spatial metamorphosis of a 420m² multi-level residence into an understated sanctuary of light, Roman travertine, and smoked European oak.
projects.vision: The client requested a complete departure from heavy, compartmentalized 1990s construction toward a fluid, serene residence inspired by Mediterranean minimalism. The vision required flooding the living core with diffused sunlight while establishing dedicated gallery niches for private art collections.
projects.transformation: We stripped the interior down to its structural concrete skeleton, removing six interior load-partition walls and replacing them with hidden structural steel beams. The former maze of dark corridors was transformed into a continuous 14-meter visual axis spanning the grand foyer, sunken lounge, and dining pavilion. A custom floating travertine fireplace divides living zones without interrupting sightlines.

gallery.alt_text: Villa Aurès grand living pavilion with floating travertine wall
Minimalist kitchen island with solid stone waterfall edge
Master suite gallery opening onto private landscaped terrace
Sunken conversation pit with bespoke bouclé seating

projects.title: Penthouse Hydra — Monolithic Luxury
projects.scope: Full Penthouse Renovation, Custom Kitchen & Automated Architectural Lighting
projects.description: A 260m² top-floor duplex penthouse overlooking the Mediterranean bay, rendered in warm greige plaster, bronze metalwork, and sculptural monolithic stone.
projects.vision: To design an executive pied-à-terre that balances intimate evening warmth with striking architectural drama. The client desired seamless concealed storage where every technical installation disappears into the architecture.
projects.transformation: Rebuilt the entire upper floor into a glass-enclosed master suite with a cantilevered dressing room and open bath. The kitchen features a 4.2-meter island carved from Greek Volakas marble with touch-to-open walnut cabinetry that conceals the back-pantry and coffee bar behind motorized pocket panels.

gallery.alt_text: Hydra penthouse living volume with bespoke lounge elements
Monolithic Volakas marble kitchen island with concealed appliances
Master bath en-suite with freestanding stone bathtub and sunset light

projects.title: The Stone Gallery Kitchen — Culinary Transformation
projects.scope: Complete Kitchen Demolition, Custom Millwork & Architectural Lighting
projects.description: A masterclass in culinary elegance featuring book-matched Calacatta Viola marble, integrated concealed extraction, and tactile dark fumed oak cabinetry.
projects.vision: Convert an outdated, closed-off utility kitchen into an open theatrical show kitchen capable of hosting intimate 10-person chef dinners while preserving immaculate minimalism during everyday family life.
projects.transformation: Demolished the structural dividing masonry to fuse the culinary space with the breakfast atrium. Engineered a 3.8-meter seamless cantilevered island counter with integrated induction flush-mount cooktops. All utility fridges, wine cellars, and cleaning appliances are hidden behind flush walnut pocket portals.

gallery.alt_text: Calacatta Viola marble island and dark oak cabinetry
Precision drawers with solid timber dove-tail organizers

projects.title: Sanctuary Master Bath — Thermal Wellness
projects.scope: Complete Bathroom Overhaul, Waterproofing, Stone Slab Works & Lighting
projects.description: An organic private spa suite conceived in seamless micro-cement, honed silver travertine, ambient coves, and heated volcanic stone benches.
projects.vision: Transform a cramped 14m² cold-tiled bathroom into a restorative 28m² wellness suite reminiscent of a high-end Swiss alpine thermal bath.
projects.transformation: Merged an adjacent redundant storage room into the bath footprint. Created a monolithic zero-entry double rain shower with hidden trench drains, a custom soaking tub placed before a private bamboo garden lightwell, and floating fluted oak double basins with brushed champagne fixtures.

gallery.alt_text: Freestanding stone bathtub with floor-mounted brushed champagne spout

projects.title: Atelier Privé — Corporate Executive Studio
projects.scope: Commercial Architecture, Acoustic Wall Paneling & Executive Furnishings
projects.description: A refined 180m² corporate headquarters and private boardroom designed with acoustic fabric paneling, dark bronze dividers, and museum lighting.
projects.vision: Provide an international investment advisory firm with a high-prestige executive office that conveys authority, quiet luxury, and confidential acoustic isolation.
projects.transformation: Engineered double-glazed frameless acoustic partition suites with custom internal bronze mesh. Installed curved fluted oak ceiling baffles that conceal high-velocity low-noise HVAC ducts while directing ambient dimmable 2700K illumination.

gallery.alt_text: Executive boardroom table in solid smoked oak with hidden AV connectivity

projects.title: Haussmannian Heritage Revival — Historic Apartment
projects.scope: Historic Preservation, Floor Restoration, Structural Reinforcement & Decoration
projects.description: Restoration of a grand 1920s 310m² historic apartment with 3.8m ceilings, preserving ornate plaster moldings while infusing contemporary Italian furniture.
projects.vision: Bridge century-old architectural grandeur with modern living requirements. The historical plaster mouldings and herringbone parquet needed meticulous artisanal restoration.
projects.transformation: Painstakingly hand-restored original gypsum cornices and ceiling rosettes. Repaired and refinished 100-year-old French oak herringbone floors with organic matte Danish oil. Reconfigured rear service quarters into an open light-filled chef pantry and private master suite.

gallery.alt_text: Restored grand salon with historic high ceilings and curated designer seating

testimonials.content: Working with BESSAM DECORATEUR redefined our expectations of what a renovation in Algeria could achieve. Their discipline with materials, punctuality on milestone delivery, and respect for millimeter precision gave our villa an architectural calm we cherish every day.

From the very first 3D concept through to the handover of our bespoke kitchen and stone works, BESSAM.DECO conducted the renovation like an orchestra. The level of craftsmanship and clean finish in the joinery is second to none.

The acoustic isolation, material richness, and architectural lighting implemented by BESSAM.DECO immediately elevated our corporate identity. Highly recommended for demanding clients who value discretion and uncompromising quality.
